proposal.diagnosis: The issue lies in how the tokenizer handles input starting with a semicolon `;`. The code incorrectly processes characters following `;` as part of the token stream instead of treating them as a comment that should be ignored. Specifically, at line 165, when `ch` is not `59` (semicolon), it sets `id=2`, indicating a comment start. However, subsequent processing fails to correctly handle cases where characters after `;` are not part of the comment structure, leading to erroneous token generation.
